credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Close up portrait of Helen Rockefeller with face turned to the right, wearing a wide brimmed hat with a chin strap, and a sleeveless black v-neck top.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Helen Rockefeller)
